statement: For every supplied well-typed labelled profile with simple support H, fixed incidence B, valid fixed support degree/common-neighbor moments, and nonempty allowed exterior-pair bit sets, the complete construction using equivalent AND and prefix-threshold gates is satisfiable exactly when a labelled SRG(v,k,1,2) completion with that H/B/profile and those pair restrictions exists; each accepted free-edge assignment has exactly one auxiliary extension. In the 17+82 case this concerns only the one supplied count profile, and unrestricted fixed-profile equivalence additionally requires independently justified necessary pair restrictions.
assumptions: Complete well-typed supplied labelled profile and simple undirected H/B domain.
Fixed support degrees equal k and off-diagonal H^2+B B^T+H entries equal 2.
Allowed bit sets apply to distinct labelled exterior copies, including equal-type copies, and are nonempty where copies coexist.
All three cardinality families are emitted completely with the exact equivalent frozen logical semantics.
Removing pair restrictions without changing the completion family requires an independently established necessary-bit premise.
Any actual byte formula requires separate complete formula/variable/group verification and its genuine runtime receipt.

scope.generic_parameters: SRG(v,k,1,2) with supplied valid support moments
scope.unique_auxiliary_extension: For every accepted free exterior-edge assignment in the complete logical formula.

mathematical_basis: Direct block expansion of the SRG degree/common-neighbor identity and explicit Boolean-gate/threshold induction; no earlier claim is used as a proof waiver.
